title: JOVRA Studio UsageReservation (jovra.usage-reservation/1)
description: An idempotent hold of Studio Credits against an accepted quote, keyed by (projectId, planRevision, outputSpecSha256), all computed server-side from the stored plan version; the quote carries the same outputSpecSha256 and funds only this reservation. One key has exactly one reservation: after budget_exceeded an accepted re-quote tops it up (another reserve entry; quoteId and capCredits then name the newest quote) instead of opening a second hold. Entries are keyed too: reserve by the request key, consume by stage (key consume:jobId:stage:attempt, at most one consume entry per jobId and stage, written when an attempt succeeds, so a failed attempt is not charged and a retry never charges a stage twice), release by outcome, so a retried request or a redelivered queue message can never charge twice. Estimates, consumption and releases are kept apart. Demo identities never reserve; test reservations are Sample; live charging waits for its own ADR.

key.description: reserve:<projectId>:<planRevision>:<outputSpecSha256> (the record's own idempotency key; one initial entry, first) or that key plus :topup:<quoteId>; consume:<jobId>:<stage>:<attempt> (this record's job, a charged stage spelled as in the job contract); release:<jobId>:<outcome> (ready, failed or canceled, matching status). The prefix is the entry kind.
